entry.title: Open Gemini 4 Argon Robot Harness: a zero-shot bimanual handover case study 🤖

link.title: Open Gemini 4 Argon Robot Harness: a zero-shot bimanual handover case study 🤖

entry.content: An open reimplementation of the observation-and-motion-primitive interface from Google’s Gemini 4 Argon robotics report, extended to two arms and tested on a zero-shot bimanual handover. Read the case study · Code.
entry.summary: An open harness for Gemini-driven robot control, extended to two arms, tested on a zero-shot clamp handover.
